Title: Data sets
Description: Half-bridge module: meshes, data sets and operating points (genBoardPFHB.py)

Para.Name: Coarse grid
Para.Description: lateral grid spacing dx = dy of the coarse mesh

Para.Name: Coarse row height
Para.Description: maximum height of a node row of the coarse mesh

Para.Name: Coarse rows per layer
Para.Description: maximum number of node rows per layer of the coarse mesh

Para.Name: Medium grid
Para.Description: lateral grid spacing of the medium mesh

Para.Name: Medium row height
Para.Description: maximum height of a node row of the medium mesh

Para.Name: Medium rows per layer
Para.Description: maximum number of node rows per layer of the medium mesh

Para.Name: Fine grid
Para.Description: lateral grid spacing of the fine mesh

Para.Name: Fine row height
Para.Description: maximum height of a node row of the fine mesh

Para.Name: Fine rows per layer
Para.Description: maximum number of node rows per layer of the fine mesh

Para.Name: Training boards
Para.Description: labelled boards of the training set (condition and chip positions vary, centres outside the band x_c = 12-16 mm)

Para.Name: Profiles per training board
Para.Description: random operating-point profiles per training board

Para.Name: Validation boards
Para.Description: labelled boards of the validation set (early stopping)

Para.Name: Physics-only boards
Para.Description: boards without simulation (only C, G, Bp) for the physics loss of the network

Para.Name: Test boards T1
Para.Description: boards of the test set T1 (inside the training domain)

Para.Name: Sampling time
Para.Description: sampling time of all profiles and models

Para.Name: Profile length
Para.Description: length of the training, validation and test profiles T1-T3

Para.Name: Mission length
Para.Description: length of the drive-cycle mission T4 (from cold)

Para.Name: Field decimation
Para.Description: the full temperature field is stored every dec samples (POD snapshots, field errors); the sensors are stored at every sample

Para.Name: DC-link voltage
Para.Description: DC-link voltage of the half-bridge

Para.Name: Switching frequency
Para.Description: PWM switching frequency

Para.Name: Junction temperature
Para.Description: junction temperature of the device parameters (fixed, linear thermal model)

Para.Name: Maximum current
Para.Description: maximum phase current amplitude of the random operating points (0 ... Imax)

Para.Name: Minimum output frequency
Para.Description: minimum output frequency (start-up, stall: losses alternate between high and low side)

Para.Name: Maximum output frequency
Para.Description: maximum output frequency (nominal operation: high and low side carry the same mean loss)

Para.Name: Minimum hold time
Para.Description: minimum duration of a random operating point

Para.Name: Maximum hold time
Para.Description: maximum duration of a random operating point
